question: Can a small causal-order union of complete native modules reproduce the natural is/was write into the shared temporal-Q8 state on untouched rows?

frozen_search.discovery_rows: The 16 rows used by the module atlas: first four each of v2 A1/A2 and v3 A1/A2.
frozen_search.confirmation_rows: The untouched remaining 48 rows: indices 4+ from each v2/v3 A1/A2 family.
frozen_search.selection: In causal order, greedily add four distinct sites. At each step evaluate every remaining addition on discovery and minimize the equal-weight mean of normalized shared-Q8 coordinate MSE and normalized target-margin-effect MSE. Freeze the prefix of length 1--4 with minimum discovery objective; ties use candidate-pool order.
frozen_search.target: The unchanged released-cDAS coefficient times its temporal-Q8 projected axis, installed at resid18.

predictions.pred_a_exact_authority_alignment_identit: All native/self/target identities, row disjointness, causal ordering, candidate coverage, finite objectives, and price controls pass.
predictions.pred_b_selected_union_predicts_shared_q8: Flattened coordinate cosine is at least 0.80 and relative coordinate RMSE at most 0.75 on 48 untouched rows.
predictions.pred_c_selected_union_predicts_shared_be: Target-effect prediction cosine is at least 0.90, relative RMSE at most 0.50, and every family has positive signed mean effect.
predictions.pred_d_greedy_union_beats_singleton_and_: Selected-union coordinate RMSE is at most 80% of best singleton and no worse than all eight candidates on confirmation.
predictions.pred_e_program_is_small_and_attention_sp: The selected prefix has at most four modules; any next head split is restricted to attention modules in that prefix.

decision: A pass promotes a compact natural upstream program and licenses head splitting only within selected attention modules. A null records distributed interaction not captured by four complete modules and redirects to source-position or weight-mode splitting, not a larger greedy sweep on these rows.
